labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The dashboard cluster addon was removed, so deployments relying on it must migrate to a separate installation.

labels.label: context
labels.reason: The in-tree Azure plugin is only deprecated and logs a warning, with an out-of-tree replacement named and no removal in this release.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The --address and --port flags in kube-controller-manager are removed in v1.24, so any configuration still passing them will fail.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: The Go struct field for metadata.clusterName was renamed to surface accidental client uses, which can break code that compiles against the old name and signals future removal.

labels.label: risk
labels.reason: vSphere releases below 7.0u2 are deprecated with support ending October 15, 2022, and the vSphere CSI Driver requires at least 7.0u2, so affected environments need upgrades.
